# RetroPlay

> RetroPlay — Classic worlds, ready to play. An independent browser hub by Mahan Tavakoli (MahanKenway) for open-source, free-content classic games and experimental browser runtimes.

## Identity
- Creator: Mahan Tavakoli (MahanKenway) — https://github.com/MahanKenway
- Official site: https://mahankenway.github.io/RetroPlay/
- Repository: https://github.com/MahanKenway/RetroPlay
- Primary language: English
- Type: static browser-game hub

## Machine-readable discovery
- Catalog JSON: https://mahankenway.github.io/RetroPlay/data/games.json
- Agent manifest: https://mahankenway.github.io/RetroPlay/agent-manifest.json
- Agent guide: https://mahankenway.github.io/RetroPlay/agent/
- Sitemap: https://mahankenway.github.io/RetroPlay/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://mahankenway.github.io/RetroPlay/robots.txt
- Privacy: https://mahankenway.github.io/RetroPlay/privacy/

## What RetroPlay offers
- Direct browser runtimes for action, adventure, strategy, racing, puzzle, rhythm, horror, survival and experimental games.
- A semantic catalog with direct links, descriptions, genre, runtime type, status, controls and license context.
- Keyboard, touch, gamepad and fullscreen support where the runtime supports them.
- Local saves, local library pins, theme preferences and opt-in retro audio.
- A separate local WAD importer for compatible files owned by the player; WAD files are not uploaded to RetroPlay.

## Important terminology
- Ready / bundled: the browser package includes the lawful free content needed to start.
- Local-data runtime: RetroPlay ships the engine but the player selects compatible lawful data locally.
- External project: RetroPlay links to the official project or download and does not repackage that game.
- OpenResident: intentionally a non-playable technical WebGL2/WASM study; no Resident Evil game data is bundled.

## Rights
RetroPlay keeps upstream attribution and license notices with each runtime. It does not present commercial game data as bundled free content and does not create fake external profiles or citations.
